name: Night Post Guard
description: Prevents late-night accidents: posts made during the hours you set (1:00-5:00 by default) automatically have their visibility lowered from Public to Home, optionally with a CW added. The time-based counterpart of Post Guard. On NoteDeck the post form menu also gets "Schedule for N:00 in the morning", which turns the draft into a scheduled post for the next morning (uses the scheduled-post feature of Misskey 2025.10+).
